args.title: Summary: Halvorsen warehouse automation articles (2026)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.halvorsen.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece (https://insights.halvorsen.example/warehouse/companion):

- Autonomous carts drove an 18% increase in pick rates in 2026 warehouse automation deployments.
- Integration took twice as long as originally planned.
- The biggest saving came from a reduction in mis-picks (companion piece).
